author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am willing to accept a longer lead time for every model deployment to guarantee that the registry remains fully compliant. If we automate the intake, we risk missing the nuanced edge cases in our data governance rules. I will trade speed for certainty here. I am prepared to wait an extra two to three days for each new version to pass through my manual review. That delay is a price I am happy to pay to ensure we never ship a model that violates our privacy constraints. The registry must be a gate, not a conveyor belt. I am giving up the ability to deploy rapidly in exchange for a defensible, audited trail that proves every artifact was vetted by a human before it touched production.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up rapid deployment speed in exchange for compliance certainty and an audited trail.
